title: Share of US adults with no landline (wireless-only)

source.name: Wireless Substitution: Early Release of Estimates from the National Health Interview Survey
source.publisher: National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), CDC

notes: Share of US adults living in a household with wireless (cell) phone service only, no landline, from the semiannual NCHS/NHIS Wireless Substitution early-release series: 24.9% in 2010, 44.1% in 2014 (about 106 million adults), 73.2% by the end of 2022, roughly 76% by 2023-2024 (most recent release).
